title: Identify female patients who were admitted to the hospital and have at leas
question: Identify female patients who were admitted to the hospital and have at least one laboratory test showing either abnormal albumin or abnormal total protein. Among them, return the IDs and current ages of those whose LDH exceeds 600 (indicating significant elevation) and whose RF is within normal limits (< 20).

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    p."XCL_058",
    CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', p."XCL_060") AS INTEGER) AS "current_age"
FROM "Patient" AS p
WHERE p."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND p."XCL_058" IN (
    SELECT e."XCL_001"
    FROM "Examination" AS e
    WHERE e."XCL_013" > 0
  )
  AND p."XCL_058" IN (
    SELECT l."XCL_014"
    FROM "Laboratory" AS l
    WHERE (l."XCL_031" < 3.5 OR l."XCL_031" > 5.0)
       OR (l."XCL_020" < 6.0 OR l."XCL_020" > 8.5)
  )
  AND p."XCL_058" IN (
    SELECT l."XCL_014"
    FROM "Laboratory" AS l
    WHERE l."XCL_018" > 600
  )
  AND p."XCL_063" = '-'

       CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y',T1."XCL_060") AS INTEGER) AS "current_age"
